requiredPatternComponents.reason: Directly observed in the four-view generated concept: fitted ivory long-sleeve jacket, high collar, one diagonal overlapping chest panel, and small quilted elbow panels. Exact seams, closures, ease, scale, and fit remain unverified.

researchTrial.method: Validate hash-bound construction inputs, manufacture an editable 3D prototype, and directly review its rendered appearance before completion.
researchTrial.review: The concept shows jacket, overskirt, and shorts appearance; it does not establish sewing order, dimensions, allowance, fabric stretch, avatar fitting, or deformation.

bodyProfileEvidence.evidenceBoundary: Neutral and repository-defined Large body cross-sections only. Reuse is bound to the same byte-identical SiroinoSotai PC FBX; waistline selection, garment ease, collar circumference, shape-key coverage, fit, and motion remain unapproved.

releaseBoundary: Prototype geometry only. Rendered visualAppearanceReview, fit, runtime, and customer release evidence remain unverified and mandatory before release.

shapeKeyTransfer.evidenceBoundary: Transfers only the declared body-size keys from the exact source triangle used for weight mapping. It records source and output mesh evidence; it does not claim smoothness, evaluated fit, Unity import compatibility, or release acceptance.

poseResponseTrial.evidenceBoundary: Prototype-only Blender Cloth timeline with the actual target armature driving the collision body and the shared overskirt waist pins before Cloth evaluation. Posed customer renders continue to use the exported rest-shape skinning path; this trial does not create runtime cloth, and does not prove fit or collision safety.

clothSimulation.evidence: V162 adds an animated target-body collider and Hips-weighted shared waistband pins before Cloth evaluation for a bounded neutral-crouch-sit-prone-neutral sweep. The saved garment remains the neutral end frame after the solve. Pose samples bind evaluated avatar, garment, and pin coordinates. Posed product renders still use armature skinning; this does not export runtime cloth or grant fit, appearance, or release acceptance.
clothSimulation.reason: V161's direct review rejected severe skirt pleat collapse and identified that its target collision body was static while the garment waist pins were fixed in world space. V162 isolates those missing inputs without changing the jacket, shorts, pattern seams, panel count, or authored pleat layout. Check real body-pose and Hips-pin motion across a continuous native Cloth cache, then directly inspect the fresh neutral and posed product renders. The sweep is prototype diagnostics only, not a fit, coverage, collision-safety, appearance, or release pass.

jacket-sleeves.reason: Direct review shows excessive sleeve wrinkling in the neutral render. Compare a structured sleeve cloth setting with the existing 0.45 baseline; 2.2 is a local prototype trial value, not a Lilac fabric calibration.
jacket-sleeves.evidenceBoundary: One neutral 48-frame trial against the current jacket sleeve panels; this parameter experiment does not establish fit, motion, material behavior, appearance approval, or release readiness.

jacket-sleeves.reason: Direct neutral and pose renders still show physical sleeve corrugation after the bounded cloth solve. Compare a low-strength interior-only fairing pass while locking all open garment boundaries and sewn pins.
jacket-sleeves.evidenceBoundary: Three post-bake uniform Laplacian iterations at factor 0.18 on non-boundary sleeve vertices only. Exact source, displacement statistics, fixed-boundary count, and resulting mesh hashes are recorded by this run. This is a geometry hypothesis only; it does not establish fit, fold quality, motion, appearance approval, or release readiness.

frontClosure.construction: Right-front hem crosses center by 40 mm in local pattern coordinates, tapering to zero at the upper opening; left front supplies continuous underlay to center. Existing shoulder and side seams retain their common vertices.
frontClosure.evidenceBoundary: Corrects a cut-away lower front into an actual overlap hypothesis. 40 mm extension and 2 mm spacing are design hypotheses, not avatar-approved ease. Closure anchoring, dynamic overlap separation, trim and final fit remain unverified.

prototypeWeightRegions.evidenceBoundary: V80 keeps the connected-panel profile shared across overskirt panels to preserve seam continuity while reducing thigh attachment to the legs in seated/crouch poses. Uncalibrated prototype hypothesis only.

weightProfile.evidenceBoundary: V146 changes the rest-pose geometry path for the sewn front-lap panels by placing them against measured UpperLeg_L/UpperLeg_R deform surfaces with seam fades. The placement is not shape-key fit, motion, collision, seam, visual, or release evidence.

prototypeWeightRegions.evidenceBoundary: V91 keeps the four shorts panels and gusset on the existing experimental weight profile. The generated surface-copy thigh covers are excluded from that profile so their vertices retain barycentric source-body skin weights. This is an uncalibrated prototype hypothesis and grants no fit or appearance acceptance.

weightProfile.evidenceBoundary: Existing V85 prototype distribution is carried onto the V87 gusset for skinning coverage only; no change to measured behavior is claimed. Seam strain, crotch deformation, weight continuity and pose response remain unverified.

prototypeWeightRegions.evidenceBoundary: V91 transfers each copied thigh-cover vertex from the nearest eligible target-avatar body triangle with barycentric source skin weights, without the shorts-panel weight profile. The shell is only an offset copy of neutral body surface; transfer accuracy in motion, seam continuity, fit and shape-key response remain unverified.
